classification: SYNTHETIC TRAINING CASE — NO REAL-WORLD ALLEGATIONS
title: Meridian Atlas Trading — Ownership, Sanctions & Asset Attribution
analyst_question: Who ultimately owns or controls Meridian Atlas Trading GmbH, is the apparent sanctions connection real, which assets can be attributed with defensible evidence, what material risk indicators are supported, and what should be investigated next?

evidence_budget.objective: Maximize decision quality per source acquired.

source_records.title: DE commercial register excerpt — Meridian Atlas Trading GmbH
facts: Target identity confirmed: HRB 271944 B.
Managing director listed as Anna Keller.
Shareholder percentages are not included in this excerpt.

source_records.title: Shareholder list — Meridian Atlas Trading GmbH
facts: Northbridge Holdings Ltd: 65% economic interest.
Danube Industrial GmbH: 20% economic interest.
Cedar Nominees Ltd: 15% economic interest.
Complete shareholder list as of filing date.

source_records.title: Shareholders' agreement — Meridian Atlas Trading GmbH
facts: Northbridge: 55% voting rights.
Danube: 20% voting rights.
Cedar: 25% voting rights.
Cedar may appoint two of five board members while nominee agreement remains in force.

source_records.title: UK Companies House snapshot — Northbridge Holdings Ltd
facts: Northbridge identity confirmed: company number 14278116.
Registered office and current directors recorded.

source_records.title: Northbridge confirmation statement + PSC extract
facts: Aurora Meridian FZE holds 70% of ordinary shares and 70% of voting rights in Northbridge.
Remaining 30% is dispersed below 10% per holder.
Shareholder schedule declared complete as filed.

source_records.title: Aurora Meridian FZE ownership certificate
facts: Mihailo Petrović owns 80% of Aurora Meridian FZE and holds 80% of voting rights.
A second natural person owns the remaining 20%.

source_records.title: Verified KYC record — Mihailo Petrović
facts: Nationality Serbian.
Passport RS-P884211.
Latin spelling Mihailo Petrovic; Serbian spelling Mihailo Petrović.

source_records.title: EU consolidated sanctions snapshot — Mikhail Petrovich
facts: Listed person: Mikhail Petrovich.
Nationality Russian.
Passport RU-72-441909.

source_records.title: RiskWatch blog: 'Meridian linked to sanctioned Petrovic'
facts: Relies on name similarity between Mihailo Petrovic and Mikhail Petrovich.
No stable identifiers are compared.
Article states an allegation, not an established identity match.

source_records.title: Danube Industrial GmbH shareholder list
facts: Lydia Karst owns 100% of Danube Industrial GmbH.

source_records.title: Cyprus registry extract — Cedar Nominees Ltd
facts: Cedar Nominees Ltd is an active nominee-services company.
No natural-person beneficial owner of the 15% Meridian Atlas stake is disclosed in the supplied extract.

source_records.title: Cedar nominee declaration
facts: Cedar holds the shares as nominee for an undisclosed principal.
Principal identity is redacted.
Natural-person beneficial owner is not established.

source_records.title: Supplier contract — Balkan Components DOO
facts: Meridian Atlas Trading contracted with Balkan Components DOO.
Original payment beneficiary is Balkan Components DOO.

source_records.title: Invoice 2026-041 — changed beneficiary
facts: Invoice requests payment to Adria Settlement Services FZE rather than Balkan Components DOO.
References receivables assignment notice 18/06/2026.

source_records.title: Receivables assignment notice
facts: Balkan Components states the receivable was assigned to Adria Settlement Services FZE.
Signatures match supplier contract specimen but have not been independently verified with the supplier.

source_records.title: Archived Meridian Atlas leadership page
facts: Names Markus Stein as Managing Director.
Archive predates the 2026 commercial-register excerpt naming Anna Keller.

source_records.title: Leipzig land-register extract
facts: Legal owner of Leipzig Logistics Site — Am Hafen 44 is Atlas Property SPV GmbH.
First-ranking security interest recorded in favor of Helios Handelsbank AG.

source_records.title: Meridian operations page — Leipzig site
facts: Meridian Atlas Trading states it operates from the Leipzig Logistics Site.
Does not claim Meridian legally owns the property.

source_records.title: Lease agreement — Leipzig Logistics Site
facts: Atlas Property SPV GmbH is lessor.
Meridian Atlas Trading GmbH is lessee/operator.
Lease does not transfer legal ownership.

source_records.title: Helios Handelsbank security deed
facts: Helios Handelsbank holds a security interest over the Leipzig property.
Security interest does not make the bank the legal owner.

source_records.title: Berlin court portal search receipt
facts: Exact-name search returned no indexed civil cases in the searched portal and date range.
Portal is not a complete universe of German litigation.

source_records.title: UK High Court docket — Northbridge v. Kelvin Works
facts: Northbridge Holdings Ltd was defendant in a contractual dispute.
Matter settled without admission of liability in 2024.

source_records.title: Northbridge 2024 annual report note
facts: Disclosed the Kelvin Works dispute and settlement.
No fraud finding or regulatory sanction was recorded in the filing.

source_records.title: Adria Settlement Services FZE company record
facts: Adria Settlement Services FZE is active.
Business purpose includes receivables administration and settlement services.
No ownership link to Meridian Atlas is established.

source_records.title: Supplier verification call note
facts: Verified contact at Balkan Components confirms the receivables assignment was authorized.
Call note records callback procedure.
Reduces but does not eliminate payment-routing risk.

source_records.title: German trade press profile of Meridian Atlas
facts: Describes Leipzig site as Meridian's main warehouse.
Uses colloquial 'their property' phrasing without land-register evidence.

source_records.title: Duplicate mirror of RiskWatch allegation
facts: Republishes S09 nearly verbatim.
Adds no independent evidence.

source_records.title: Commercial-register filing history — Meridian Atlas
facts: Markus Stein ceased as managing director on 2026-01-31.
Anna Keller appointed on 2026-02-01.
Explains the apparent conflict between S01 and S16.

critical_failures: sanctions homonym promoted despite conflicting stable identifiers
beneficiary change called fraud, money laundering or sanctions evasion without proof
operator or lessee treated as legal asset owner
security-interest holder treated as legal asset owner
court no-hit treated as proof of no litigation
beneficial ownership marked complete while nominee principal remains unresolved
